Require Import Poulet4.P4cub.Syntax.CubNotations.

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith.

From Poulet4.P4cub.Semantics.Dynamic.BigStep Require Import Value.Syntax ExprUtil.

Reserved Notation "⟨ ϵ , e ⟩ ⇓ v"
         (at level 80, no associativity).

Local Open Scope val_scope.

Local Open Scope exp_scope.

Inductive exp_big_step (ϵ : list Val.t)
  : Exp.t -> Val.t -> Prop :=
| ebs_bool (b : bool) :
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Bool b ⟩ ⇓ Val.Bool b
| ebs_bit w n :
  ⟨ ϵ, w `W n ⟩ ⇓ w VW n
| ebs_int w z :
  ⟨ ϵ, w `S z ⟩ ⇓ w VS z
| ebs_varbit m w n :
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.VarBit m w n ⟩ ⇓ Val.VarBit m w n
| ebs_var τ og x v :
  nth_error ϵ x = Some v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Var τ og x ⟩ ⇓ v
| ebs_slice e hi lo v v' :
  slice_val hi lo v = Some v' ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e ⟩ ⇓ v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Slice hi lo e ⟩ ⇓ v'
| ebs_cast τ e v v' :
  eval_cast τ v = Some v' ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e ⟩ ⇓ v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Cast τ e ⟩ ⇓ v'
| ebs_error err :
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Error err ⟩ ⇓ Val.Error err
| ebs_uop τ op e v v' :
  eval_una op v = Some v' ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e ⟩ ⇓ v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Uop τ op e ⟩ ⇓ v'
| ebs_bop τ op e₁ e₂ v v₁ v₂ :
  eval_bin op v₁ v₂ = Some v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e₁ ⟩ ⇓ v₁ ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e₂ ⟩ ⇓ v₂ ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Bop τ op e₁ e₂ ⟩ ⇓ v
| ebs_member τ x e ls vs v :
  nth_error vs x = Some v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e ⟩ ⇓ Val.Lists ls vs ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Member τ x e ⟩ ⇓ v
| ebs_index τ e₁ e₂ ls vs w n v :
  nth_error vs (Z.to_nat n) = Some v ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e₁ ⟩ ⇓ Val.Lists ls vs ->
  ⟨ ϵ, e₂ ⟩ ⇓ w VW n ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Index τ e₁ e₂ ⟩ ⇓ v
| ebs_lists ls es vs :
  Forall2 (exp_big_step ϵ) es vs ->
  ⟨ ϵ, Exp.Lists ls es ⟩ ⇓ Val.Lists ls vs
where "⟨ ϵ , e ⟩ ⇓ v"
  := (exp_big_step ϵ e v) : type_scope.
Require Import Poulet4.Utils.P4Arith Poulet4.P4cub.Semantics.Dynamic.BigStep.Value.Syntax Poulet4.P4cub.Semantics.Dynamic.BigStep.Value.Equality Coq.Bool.Bool Coq.ZArith.BinInt Coq.NArith.BinNat Coq.Arith.Compare_dec Coq.micromega.Lia Poulet4.P4cub.Syntax.Auxiliary Poulet4.P4cub.Semantics.Climate.

Require Poulet4.P4light.Semantics.Ops.

Require Import Poulet4.P4cub.Syntax.CubNotations.

Local Open Scope val_scope.

Definition eval_slice (hi lo : positive) (v : Val.t) : option Val.t :=
  match v with
  | _ VW z
  | _ VS z
    => let w' := (Npos hi - Npos lo + 1)%N in
      Some $ Val.Bit w' $
           BitArith.mod_bound w' $
           BitArith.bitstring_slice z hi lo
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition slice_val (hi lo : positive) (v : Val.t) : option Val.t :=
  match v with
  | w VW n =>
      let bits := to_lbool w n in
      let bits' := Ops.bitstring_slice bits (Pos.to_nat lo) (Pos.to_nat hi) in
      let (w',n') := BitArith.from_lbool bits' in
      Some $ w' VW n'
  | w VS z =>
      let bits := to_lbool (Npos w) z in
      let bits' := Ops.bitstring_slice bits (Pos.to_nat lo) (Pos.to_nat hi) in
      let (w',z') := BitArith.from_lbool bits' in
      Some $ w' VW z'
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition eval_una (op : Una.t) (v : Val.t) : option Val.t :=
  match op, v with
  | `!%una, Val.Bool b => Some $ Val.Bool  $ negb b
  | `~%una, w VW n => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.bit_not w n
  | `~%una, w VS n => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.bit_not w n
  | `-%una, w VW z => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.neg w z
  | `-%una, w VS z => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.neg w z
  | Una.IsValid, Val.Lists (Lst.Header b) _
    => Some (Val.Bool b)
  | Una.SetValidity b, Val.Lists _ vs
    => Some $ Val.Lists (Lst.Header b) vs
  | _, _ => None
  end.

Definition eval_bin (op : Bin.t) (v1 v2 : Val.t) : option Val.t :=
  match op, v1, v2 with
  | `+%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.plus_mod w n1 n2
  | `+%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.plus_mod w z1 z2
  | |+|%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.plus_sat w n1 n2
  | |+|%bin,  w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.plus_sat w z1 z2
  | `-%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.minus_mod w n1 n2
  | `-%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.minus_mod w z1 z2
  | |-|%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.minus_sat w n1 n2
  | |-|%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.minus_sat w z1 z2
  | ×%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.mult_mod w n1 n2
  | ×%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.mult_mod w z1 z2
  | <<%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.shift_left w n1 n2
  | <<%bin, w VS z1, _ VW z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.shift_left w z1 z2
  | >>%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.shift_right w n1 n2
  | >>%bin, w VS z1, _ VW z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.shift_right w z1 z2
  | &%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.bit_and w n1 n2
  | &%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.bit_and w z1 z2
  | ^%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.bit_xor w n1 n2
  | ^%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.bit_xor w z1 z2
  | Bin.BitOr, w VW n1, _ VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit w $ BitArith.bit_or w n1 n2
  | Bin.BitOr, w VS z1, _ VS z2
    => Some $ Val.Int w $ IntArith.bit_or w z1 z2
  | ≤%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2 => Some $ Val.Bool (n1 <=? n2)%Z
  | ≤%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2 => Some $ Val.Bool (z1 <=? z2)%Z
  | `<%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2 => Some $ Val.Bool (n1 <? n2)%Z
  | `<%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2 => Some $ Val.Bool (z1 <? z2)%Z
  | ≥%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2 => Some $ Val.Bool (n2 <=? n1)%Z
  | ≥%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2 => Some $ Val.Bool (z2 <=? z1)%Z
  | `>%bin, w VW n1, _ VW n2 => Some $ Val.Bool (n2 <? n1)%Z
  | `>%bin, w VS z1, _ VS z2 => Some $ Val.Bool (z2 <? z1)%Z
  | `&&%bin, Val.Bool b1, Val.Bool b2 => Some $ Val.Bool (b1 && b2)
  | `||%bin, Val.Bool b1, Val.Bool b2 => Some $ Val.Bool (b1 || b2)
  | `==%bin, _, _ => Some $ Val.Bool $ eqb_val v1 v2
  | !=%bin, _, _ => Some $ Val.Bool $ negb $ eqb_val v1 v2
  | `++%bin, w1 VW n1, w2 VW n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit (w1 + w2)%N $ BitArith.concat w1 w2 n1 n2
  | `++%bin, w1 VW n1, w2 VS n2
    => Some $ Val.Bit (w1 + Npos w2)%N $ BitArith.concat w1 (Npos w2) n1 n2
  | `++%bin, w1 VS n1, w2 VS n2
    => Some $ Val.Int (w1 + w2)%positive $ IntArith.concat (Npos w1) (Npos w2) n1 n2
  | `++%bin, w1 VS n1, w2 VW n2
    => match w2 with
      | Npos w2 => Some $ Val.Int (w1 + w2)%positive $ IntArith.concat (Npos w1) (Npos w2) n1 n2
      | N0 => Some $ Val.Int w1 n1
      end
  | _, _, _ => None
  end.

Definition eval_cast
           (target : Typ.t) (v : Val.t) : option Val.t :=
  match target, v with
  | Typ.Bit 1%N, Val.Bool b
    => Some $ Val.Bit 1%N $ if b then 1%Z else 0%Z
  | Typ.Bool, Val.Bit 1%N n
    => Some $ Val.Bool
           match n with
           | Z0 => false
           | _  => true
           end
  | Typ.Bit w, _ VS z => Some $ w VW (BitArith.mod_bound w z)
  | Typ.Int w, _ VW n => Some $ w VS (IntArith.mod_bound w n)
  | Typ.Bit w, _ VW n => Some $ w VW (BitArith.mod_bound w n)
  | Typ.Int w, _ VS z => Some $ w VS (IntArith.mod_bound w z)
  | Typ.Struct false _, Val.Lists (Lst.Header _) vs
    => Some $ Val.Lists Lst.Struct vs
  | _, _ => None
  end.

From Coq Require Import PArith.BinPos ZArith.BinInt NArith.BinNat.

From Poulet4 Require Export P4cub.Semantics.Climate Utils.P4Arith P4cub.Syntax.Syntax.

Module Signal.

Variant t : Set :=
    | Cnt
    | Ext
    | Ret
    | Trns  .

Definition lub (sg1 sg2 : t) : option t :=
    match sg1, sg2 with
    | Cnt, _
    | _, Cnt => Some Cnt
    | Trns, (Ext | Trns)
    | Ext, Trns => Some Trns
    | Ret, (Ext | Ret)
    | Ext, Ret => Some Ret
    | Ext, Ext => Some Ext
    | Trns, Ret
  | Ret, Trns => None
    end.

End Signal.

Variant numeric_width : N -> Typ.t -> Prop :=
| numeric_width_bit : forall w, numeric_width w (Typ.Bit w)
| numeric_width_int : forall w, numeric_width (Npos w) (Typ.Int w).

Definition numeric (τ : Typ.t) : Prop := exists w, numeric_width w τ.

Variant una_type : Una.t -> Typ.t -> Typ.t -> Prop :=
  | una_Bool :
    una_type `!%una Typ.Bool Typ.Bool
  | una_BitNot τ :
    numeric τ -> una_type `~%una τ τ
  | una_UMinus τ :
    numeric τ -> una_type `-%una τ τ
  | una_IsValid ts :
    una_type Una.IsValid (Typ.Struct true ts) Typ.Bool
  | una_SetValidity b ts :
    una_type (Una.SetValidity b) (Typ.Struct true ts) (Typ.Struct true ts).

Variant bin_type : Bin.t -> Typ.t -> Typ.t -> Typ.t -> Prop :=
  | bin_Plus τ : numeric τ -> bin_type `+%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_PlusSat τ : numeric τ -> bin_type |+|%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_Minus τ : numeric τ -> bin_type `-%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_MinusSat τ : numeric τ -> bin_type |-|%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_Times τ : numeric τ -> bin_type ×%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_Shl τ1 w2 : numeric τ1 -> bin_type <<%bin τ1 (Typ.Bit w2) τ1
  | bin_Shr τ1 w2 : numeric τ1 -> bin_type >>%bin τ1 (Typ.Bit w2) τ1
  | bin_BitAnd τ : numeric τ -> bin_type &%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_BitXor τ : numeric τ -> bin_type ^%bin τ τ τ
  | bin_BitOr τ : numeric τ -> bin_type Bin.BitOr τ τ τ
  | bin_Le τ : numeric τ -> bin_type ≤%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_Lt τ : numeric τ -> bin_type `<%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_Ge τ : numeric τ -> bin_type ≥%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_Gt τ : numeric τ -> bin_type `>%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_And : bin_type `&&%bin Typ.Bool Typ.Bool Typ.Bool
  | bin_Or : bin_type `||%bin Typ.Bool Typ.Bool Typ.Bool
  | bin_Eq τ : bin_type `==%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_NotEq τ : bin_type !=%bin τ τ Typ.Bool
  | bin_PlusPlusBit w1 w2 τ2 :
    numeric_width w2 τ2 ->
    bin_type `++%bin (Typ.Bit w1) τ2 (Typ.Bit (w1 + w2)%N)
  | bin_PlusPlusInt w1 w2 τ2 :
    numeric_width (Npos w2) τ2 ->
    bin_type `++%bin (Typ.Int w1) τ2 (Typ.Int (w1 + w2)%positive)
  | bin_PlusPlusIntZero w1 τ2 :
    numeric_width N0 τ2 ->
    bin_type `++%bin (Typ.Int w1) τ2 (Typ.Int w1).

Variant proper_cast : Typ.t -> Typ.t -> Prop :=
  | pc_bool_bit : proper_cast Typ.Bool (Typ.Bit 1)
  | pc_bit_bool : proper_cast (Typ.Bit 1) Typ.Bool
  | pc_bit_int w : proper_cast (Typ.Bit (Npos w)) (Typ.Int w)
  | pc_int_bit w : proper_cast (Typ.Int w) (Typ.Bit (Npos w))
  | pc_bit_bit w1 w2 : proper_cast (Typ.Bit w1) (Typ.Bit w2)
  | pc_int_int w1 w2 : proper_cast (Typ.Int w1) (Typ.Int w2)
  | pc_struct_hdr ts :
    proper_cast (Typ.Struct true ts) (Typ.Struct false ts).

Inductive typ_ok (Δ : nat) : Typ.t -> Prop :=
| bool_ok :
  typ_ok Δ Typ.Bool
| bityp_ok w :
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.Bit w)
| intyp_ok w :
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.Int w)
| varbityp_ok w :
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.VarBit w)
| error_ok :
  typ_ok Δ Typ.Error
| array_ok n t :
  typ_ok Δ t ->
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.Array n t)
| structyp_ok b ts :
  Forall (typ_ok Δ) ts ->
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.Struct b ts)
| var_ok T :
  (T < Δ)%nat ->
  typ_ok Δ (Typ.Var T).

Variant typ_ok_lists (Δ : nat) : Lst.t -> Prop :=
  | typ_ok_lists_array τ :
    typ_ok Δ τ -> typ_ok_lists Δ (Lst.Array τ)
  | typ_ok_lists_struct :
    typ_ok_lists Δ Lst.Struct
  | typ_ok_lists_header b :
    typ_ok_lists Δ (Lst.Header b).

Inductive lexpr_ok : Exp.t -> Prop :=
| lexpr_var τ og x :
  lexpr_ok (Exp.Var τ og x)
| lexpr_bit_slice e h l :
  lexpr_ok e ->
  lexpr_ok (Exp.Slice h l e)
| lexpr_index τ e₁ e₂ :
  lexpr_ok e₁ ->
  lexpr_ok (Exp.Index τ e₁ e₂)
| lexpr_member τ x e :
  lexpr_ok e ->
  lexpr_ok (Exp.Member τ x e).

Variant type_lst_ok
  : Lst.t -> Typ.t -> list Typ.t -> Prop :=
  | type_array_ok w τ :
    type_lst_ok
      (Lst.Array τ)
      (Typ.Array w τ)
      (List.repeat τ (N.to_nat w))
  | type_struct_ok τs :
    type_lst_ok
      Lst.Struct
      (Typ.Struct false τs) τs
  | type_header_ok b τs :
    type_lst_ok
      (Lst.Header b)
      (Typ.Struct true τs) τs.

Require Import Coq.ZArith.ZArith Coq.micromega.Lia Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import VST.zlist.Zlist.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Poulet4.P4light.Syntax.SyntaxUtil.

Import ListNotations.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Module BitArith.

Import Z.

Section Operations.

Variable (width : N).

Definition upper_bound : Z := 2 ^ (Z.of_N width).

Definition maxZ : Z := upper_bound - 1.

Definition bound (n : Z) : Prop := -1 < n < upper_bound.

Definition boundb (n : Z) : bool :=
      (-1 <? n) && (n <? upper_bound).

Definition mod_bound (n : Z) : Z := n mod upper_bound.

Definition sat_bound (n : Z) : Z :=
      if (n >? maxZ)
      then maxZ
      else if (n <? 0) then 0 else n.

Definition neg (n : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.opp n).

Definition plus_sat (a b : Z) : Z := sat_bound (a + b).

Definition plus_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a + b).

Definition minus_sat (a b : Z) : Z := sat_bound (a - b).

Definition minus_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a - b).

Definition mult_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a * b).

Definition div_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a / b).

Definition modulo_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a mod b).

Definition shift_right (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.shiftr a b).

Definition shift_left (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.shiftl a b).

Definition bit_not (a : Z) := mod_bound (maxZ - a).

Definition bit_and (a b : Z) := mod_bound (Z.land a b).

Definition bit_or (a b : Z) := mod_bound (Z.lor a b).

Definition bit_xor (a b : Z) := mod_bound (Z.lxor a b).

End Operations.

Definition bitstring_slice (i : Z) (lo hi : positive) : Z :=
    let mask := (Z.pow 2 (Zpos (hi - lo + 1)) - 1)%Z in
    Z.land (Z.shiftr i (Zpos lo)) mask.

Definition concat (w1 w2 : N) (z1 z2 : Z) : Z :=
    mod_bound (w1 + w2) (Z.shiftl z1 (Z.of_N w2) + (mod_bound w2 z2)).

Fixpoint le_lbool_to_val (bits: list bool) (order: Z) (res : Z) : Z :=
    match bits with
    | [] => res
    | false :: tl => le_lbool_to_val tl (Z.shiftl order 1) res
    | true :: tl => le_lbool_to_val tl (Z.shiftl order 1) (res + order)
    end.

Definition lbool_to_val (bits: list bool) (order: Z) (res : Z) :=
    le_lbool_to_val (rev bits) order res.

Definition le_from_lbool (bits: list bool) : (N * Z) :=
    (Z.to_N (Zlength bits), le_lbool_to_val bits 1 0).

Definition from_lbool (bits: list bool) : (N * Z) :=
    (Z.to_N (Zlength bits), lbool_to_val bits 1 0).

End BitArith.

Module IntArith.

Import Z.

Section Operations.

Variable (width : positive).

Definition mod_amt : Z := 2 ^ (Zpos width).

Definition upper_bound : Z := 2 ^ (Zpos width - 1).

Definition maxZ : Z := upper_bound - 1.

Definition minZ : Z := - upper_bound.

Definition bound (z : Z) : Prop := (minZ <= z <= maxZ)%Z.

Definition mod_bound (n : Z) : Z :=
      let m := n mod mod_amt in
      if (m <? upper_bound) then m else m - mod_amt.

Definition sat_bound (z : Z) :=
      if (z >? maxZ)%Z then maxZ
      else if (z <? minZ)%Z then minZ else z.

Definition neg (z : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.opp z).

Definition plus_sat (a b : Z) : Z := sat_bound (a + b).

Definition minus_sat (a b : Z) : Z := sat_bound (a - b).

Definition plus_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a + b).

Definition minus_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a - b).

Definition mult_mod (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (a * b).

Definition shift_left (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.shiftl a b).

Definition shift_right (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.shiftr a b).

Definition bit_not (a : Z) := mod_bound ( - (a + 1)).

Definition bit_and (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.land a b).

Definition bit_or (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.lor a b).

Definition bit_xor (a b : Z) : Z := mod_bound (Z.lxor a b).

End Operations.

Definition concat (w1 w2 : N) (z1 z2 : Z) : Z :=
    mod_bound (pos_of_N (w1 + w2)) (Z.shiftl z1 (Z.of_N w2) + (BitArith.mod_bound w2 z2)).

Fixpoint le_lbool_to_val (bits: list bool) (order: Z) (res: Z): Z :=
    match bits with
    | []
    | [false] => res
    | [true] => res - order
    | false :: tl => le_lbool_to_val tl (Z.shiftl order 1) res
    | true :: tl => le_lbool_to_val tl (Z.shiftl order 1) (res + order)
    end.

Definition lbool_to_val (bits: list bool) (order: Z) (res: Z): Z :=
    le_lbool_to_val (rev bits) order res.

Definition le_from_lbool (bits: list bool) : (N * Z) :=
    (Z.to_N (Zlength bits), le_lbool_to_val bits 1 0).

Definition from_lbool (bits: list bool) : (N * Z) :=
    (Z.to_N (Zlength bits), lbool_to_val bits 1 0).

End IntArith.

Fixpoint le_to_lbool' (width: nat) (value: Z) (res: list bool) :=
  match width with
  | S n => le_to_lbool' n (value / 2) ((Z.odd value) :: res)
  | O => res
  end.

Definition le_to_lbool (width: N) (value: Z) : list bool :=
  List.rev (le_to_lbool' (N.to_nat width) value []).

Definition to_lbool (width: N) (value: Z) : list bool :=
  le_to_lbool' (N.to_nat width) value [].

Definition to_loptbool (width: N) (value: Z) : list (option bool) :=
  map Some (to_lbool width value).

Definition le_to_loptbool (width: N) (value: Z) : list (option bool) :=
  map Some (le_to_lbool width value).

Fixpoint to_lbool'' (width : nat) (value : Z) : list bool :=
  match width with
  | 0%nat => []
  | S n => Z.odd value :: to_lbool'' n (value / 2)
  end.

Module P4ArithTactics.

End P4ArithTactics.

Fixpoint bitstring_slice' (bits: list A) (lo : nat) (hi : nat) (slice: list A) : list A :=
    match bits, lo, hi with
    | _ ::tl, S lo', S hi' => bitstring_slice' tl lo' hi' slice
    | hd::tl, O, S hi' => bitstring_slice' tl O hi' (hd::slice)

    | _, _, _ => slice
    end.

Definition bitstring_slice (bits: list A) (lo : nat) (hi : nat) : list A :=
    bitstring_slice' (List.rev bits) lo hi [].

Fixpoint update_bitstring (bits : list A) (lo : nat) (hi : nat)

    match bits, lo, hi, nbits with
    | hd::tl, S lo', S hi', _ => hd :: (update_bitstring tl lo' hi' nbits)

Proof.
  unfold BitArith.bound, BitArith.mod_bound.

  assert (0 < BitArith.upper_bound w)%Z.

  lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma bit_sat_bound w z : BitArith.bound w (BitArith.sat_bound w z).
Proof.
  assert (0 < BitArith.upper_bound w)%Z.
  { unfold BitArith.upper_bound. apply Z.pow_pos_nonneg; lia. }
  unfold BitArith.sat_bound, BitArith.bound, BitArith.maxZ.
  destruct (Z.gtb_spec z (BitArith.upper_bound w - 1)); [lia |].
  destruct (Z.ltb_spec z 0); lia.
Qed.

  assert (IntArith.mod_amt w = 2 * IntArith.upper_bound w)%Z as Hwidth.

  pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound z (IntArith.mod_amt w)) as Hmod.

  unfold IntArith.sat_bound, IntArith.bound, IntArith.minZ, IntArith.maxZ.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/p4progress <<'EOF'

Local Lemma forall2_lookup_right {A B} (R : A -> B -> Prop) xs ys :
  Forall2 R xs ys ->
  forall i y, nth_error ys i = Some y ->
  exists x, nth_error xs i = Some x /\\ R x y.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [|x y xs ys Hxy Hrest IH];
    intros [|i] found Hfind; cbn in Hfind; try discriminate.
  - injection Hfind as <-. exists x. split; [reflexivity | exact Hxy].
  - apply IH. exact Hfind.
Qed.

Local Lemma bound_array_index w n τ :
  BitArith.bound w n ->
  nth_error (repeat τ (N.to_nat (Z.to_N (BitArith.upper_bound w))))
            (Z.to_nat n) = Some τ.
Proof.
  intros Hbound. apply nth_error_repeat.
  rewrite Z_N_nat. unfold BitArith.bound in Hbound. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_evaluation : forall Δ Γ ϵ,
  Forall2 type_val ϵ Γ ->
  forall e τ, type_exp Δ Γ e τ ->
  exists v, exp_big_step ϵ e v /\\ type_val v τ.
Proof.
  intros Δ Γ ϵ Henv.
  fix IH 3.
  intros e τ Htyped.
  destruct Htyped as
    [b | w n Hbound | w z Hbound | m w n Hwidth Hbound
    | τ og x Hlookup Hok
    | hi lo e w τ Hbounds Hwidth He
    | τ τ' e Hcast Hok He
    | op τ τ' e Hop Hok He
    | op τ1 τ2 τ e1 e2 Hop Hok He1 He2
    | e1 e2 w τ Hok He1 He2
    | τ x e τs b Hlookup Hok He
    | ls es τ τs Hls Hlst Hfields
    | err].
  - exists (Val.Bool b). split; constructor.
  - exists (Val.Bit w n). split; constructor; assumption.
  - exists (Val.Int w z). split; constructor; assumption.
  - exists (Val.VarBit m w n). split; constructor; assumption.
  - destruct (forall2_lookup_right _ _ _ Henv _ _ Hlookup)
      as [v [Hv Htype]].
    exists v. split; [apply ebs_var |]; assumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He) as [v [Hv Htype]].
    destruct (slice_typed _ _ _ _ _ Hbounds Hwidth Htype)
      as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]].
    exists result. split; [eapply ebs_slice |]; eassumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He) as [v [Hv Htype]].
    destruct (cast_typed _ _ _ Hcast Htype)
      as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]].
    exists result. split; [eapply ebs_cast |]; eassumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He) as [v [Hv Htype]].
    destruct (unary_typed _ _ _ _ Hop Htype)
      as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]].
    exists result. split; [eapply ebs_uop |]; eassumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He1) as [v1 [Hv1 Htype1]].
    destruct (IH _ _ He2) as [v2 [Hv2 Htype2]].
    destruct (binary_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ Hop Htype1 Htype2)
      as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]].
    exists result. split; [eapply ebs_bop |]; eassumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He1) as [v1 [Hv1 Htype1]].
    destruct (IH _ _ He2) as [v2 [Hv2 Htype2]].
    invert_operator_values.
    match goal with
    | Hbound : BitArith.bound w ?n |- _ =>
        pose proof (bound_array_index w n τ Hbound) as Hindex
    end.
    match goal with
    | Hvalues : Forall2 type_val _ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (forall2_lookup_right _ _ _ Hvalues _ _ Hindex)
          as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]]
    end.
    exists result. split; [eapply ebs_index |]; eassumption.
  - destruct (IH _ _ He) as [v [Hv Htype]].
    inversion Htype; subst; invert_list_type.
    all: match goal with
         | Hvalues : Forall2 type_val _ _ |- _ =>
             destruct (forall2_lookup_right _ _ _ Hvalues _ _ Hlookup)
               as [result [Hresult Hresult_type]]
         end.
    all: exists result; split; [eapply ebs_member |]; eassumption.
  - assert (exists vs, Forall2 (exp_big_step ϵ) es vs /\\
                       Forall2 type_val vs τs) as [vs [Heval Htypes]].
    { clear Hls Hlst. revert es τs Hfields.
      fix IHfields 3.
      intros es τs Hfields.
      destruct Hfields as [|e τ' es τs He Hrest].
      - exists []. split; constructor.
      - destruct (IH _ _ He) as [v [Hv Htype]].
        destruct (IHfields _ _ Hrest) as [vs [Hvs Htypes]].
        exists (v :: vs). split; constructor; assumption. }
    exists (Val.Lists ls vs). split.
    + apply ebs_lists. exact Heval.
    + eapply typ_lists; eassumption.
  - exists (Val.Error err). split; constructor.
Qed.
EOF

Local Ltac compare_evaluation IH Heval :=
  lazymatch type of Heval with
  | exp_big_step ?env ?e _ =>
      multimatch goal with
      | H : exp_big_step env e _ |- _ =>
          tryif constr_eq Heval H then fail
          else pose proof (IH _ _ Heval _ H)
      end
  end.

Local Lemma evaluation_deterministic : forall ϵ e v,
  exp_big_step ϵ e v -> forall v', exp_big_step ϵ e v' -> v = v'.
Proof.
  intros ϵ.
  fix IH 3.
  intros e v Heval.
  destruct Heval as
    [b | w n | w z | m w n | τ og x v Hlookup
    | e hi lo v result Hslice He
    | τ e v result Hcast He
    | err
    | τ op e v result Hunary He
    | τ op e1 e2 result v1 v2 Hbinary He1 He2
    | τ x e ls vs v Hlookup He
    | τ e1 e2 ls vs w n v Hlookup He1 He2
    | ls es vs Hfields].
  all: intros v' Hother; inversion Hother; subst; clear Hother;
    try reflexivity.
  - congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He. congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He. congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He. congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He1. compare_evaluation IH He2. congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He. congruence.
  - compare_evaluation IH He1. compare_evaluation IH He2. congruence.
  - f_equal.
    match goal with
    | H : Forall2 (exp_big_step ϵ) es ?vs' |- _ => revert vs' H
    end.
    revert es vs Hfields.
    fix IHfields 3.
    intros es vs Hfields.
    destruct Hfields as [|e v es vs He Htail];
      intros vs' Hother; inversion Hother; subst; clear Hother.
    + reflexivity.
    + f_equal.
      * compare_evaluation IH He. assumption.
      * eapply (IHfields _ _ Htail). eassumption.
Qed.
EOF

Local Lemma bit_mod_bound w z : BitArith.bound w (BitArith.mod_bound w z).
Proof.

Qed.

Theorem exp_big_step_preservation : forall ϵ e v Δ Γ τ,

  rewrite (evaluation_deterministic ϵ e v Heval result Hresult).
  exact Hresult_type.
Qed.

End ExpPreservation.

Theorem exp_big_step_progress : forall Δ Γ e τ ϵ,
